description: This file defines the SpyHashStateImpl class, a testing utility implementing the HashState API for accumulating input bytes, used for testing hash functions in the Abseil library. It includes methods for combining hash states, comparison, and debugging output.

classes.name: SpyHashStateImpl
classes.description: A class implementing HashState for testing, accumulating input bytes and supporting comparison, output, and move semantics.

methods.name: combine
methods.description: Combines multiple hash state objects and values into a new hash state.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality based on hash representation.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality based on hash representation.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two hash states for equality or suffix relationships.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the hash representation as a formatted dump.

methods.name: combine_contiguous
methods.description: Adds raw bytes to the hash state from a contiguous buffer.

methods.name: RunCombineUnordered
methods.description: Combines hash states in an unordered manner.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns error message if any, or indicates moved-from state.
